sources.evidence: Pinned official Idle-Labs/idle-contracts source commit 70b31e6ef4724e2f6e501ebb49dcc9c759ee2ea6; source pin alone is not current runtime-code, liquidity, or funded-execution certification.
Pinned migrations/addresses.js identifies Ethereum iDAI live/proxy target 0x493C57C4763932315A328269E1ADaD09653B9081 and underlying DAI 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F.

Pinned IIdleTokenV3_1 declares ordinary nonpayable mintIdleToken(uint256 _amount,bool _skipRebalance,address _referral) returning uint256 mintedTokens and redeemIdleToken(uint256 _amount) returning uint256 redeemedTokens. Interface parameter names are retained in this ABI declaration.

Pinned implementation pulls underlying and mints to caller in mintIdleToken; redemption burns caller tokens, transfers underlying and invokes rewards redemption. Its second mint bool is unnamed/unused in the implementation, unlike the named interface parameter; no compiled ABI identity is inferred from this difference. Protocol pause, allowance and liquidity remain intrinsic conditions. Other administrative, emergency and rebalance methods are excluded.
